messages:
zoe: Quick request — marketing wants violin plots of latency distributions + tail breakdowns for the upcoming quantized models. Target variants: 13B q4_0, 13B q5_0, and 70B q8_0. Need reproducibility checklist, raw CSVs, and PNGs for violin + CDF plots. Deadline Thu EOD. Can eng/runtime run?

ansh: We can. Clarify: seq lengths? concurrency sweep? streaming vs non-streaming? Also do you want cold-start runs and how do you define cold?

zoe: Seq buckets: 16, 64, 256. Concurrency: 1, 8, 24. Include streaming only on the 13B variants, non-streaming on 70B. Cold-start = first request after a fresh container (so restart between cold runs). Include steady-state after warmup for 90s.

tom: Ok scheduling note: we'll run on A100-80GB baseline and attempt one H100 batch if queue fits. We'll capture per-request latencies, compile_time flag, worker_pid, and gpu_mem_snapshots. We'll exclude obvious compile outliers from the steady-state violin but keep them in the raw CSV with a column `outlier_reason`.

zoe: Perfect. Marketing also asks for: a short reproducibility.md with exact CLI used, the artifact S3 path, and a small claims blurb we can adapt ("median p50 improvement on streaming 13B q5_0 vs q4_0"). Flag any apples-to-oranges comparisons.

ansh: Proposed run config (for reproducibility):

```
model_variants: [redwood-13b-q4_0, redwood-13b-q5_0, redwood-70b-q8_0]
seq_lengths: [16,64,256]
concurrency: [1,8,24]
warmup_seconds: 30
steady_seconds: 90
streaming_enabled: [true,true,false]
random_seed: 42
payload_set: mkting-violin-2026-03-18
metrics: [per_request_ms,p50,p90,p95,p99,cdf,compile_time_flag]
artifact_prefix: s3://redwood-marketing/violin-2065432100/
```

ansh: We'll also generate CDF + violin PNGs per seq_length x model_variant and a small table with p50/p95/p99 + first_token_ms.

marketing-bot: Reminder: please attach the artifact README with reproduction commands and include the payload hash for verification.

zoe: One more ask: include node_type column (A100/H100), kernel_version, and quant_backend (xT, pg_quant) in CSV so legal/sales can validate claims.

tom: Noted. Schedule: enqueue Thu 08:30 UTC. ETA for artifacts Fri 12:00 UTC (unless H100 sample delays). We'll post artifact link here and tag marketing.

eng-scheduler: Job queued: violin-bench-2065432100-01 created by ansh, scheduled Thu 08:30 UTC.

zoe: Awesome — please ping me when CSVs + PNGs land. If anything looks weird (large variance or undeterministic tails) call it out in the README. Thanks! :sparkles:
